name: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (nos)
benefit: 1. 50 % of cost of equipment subject to a maximum of ₹ 15,000 for General and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 20,000/- for SC/ST 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a large cardamom grower located in Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should submit the application for consideration under the scheme in the prescribed format.
